title: The Borrowed Reel
verdict: Anya Rowe was responsible for the disappearance of a cellar inventory ledger.
intent: Anya Rowe wanted to hide missing reserve bottles before the investors arrived.
The culprit needed delayed discovery so the object could pass the first search and be recovered later.
action_schema: Use role-specific access: the cellar manager went below to reset the alarm after the last cabinet check.
Remove a cellar inventory ledger from its checked location.
Hide the item in an empty magnum bottle case.
Allow incomplete suspicion to fall on distractor suspects.
evidence_cues: a cellar inventory ledger disappeared from a vineyard tasting room before an investor visit.
The object was confirmed present before the relevant disturbance.
The disappearance occurred within a narrow time window because the cellar humidity alarm was reset twice.
The physical trace was purple wax flakes near the locked cabinet.
The relevant tool or mechanism was a corkscrew with ledger paper caught in the hinge.
The item could be concealed in an empty magnum bottle case.
The hiding place required insider knowledge because only the cellar manager knew the cabinet hinge stuck unless lifted from below.
distractor_cues: a delivery driver with access to bottle cases
a host upset about a promotion
A visible conflict is suspicious but insufficient without timing and mechanism.
A bulky object or nervous behavior is insufficient unless it explains the hidden container.
